messages:
alice: onboarding a community Llama variant produced garbled output when we hot-swapped mid-session to a Mistral-compiled variant. standalone runs fine.
ben: can you share a repro?
alice: repro: start session on llama-int4 quant, then switch to mistral-compiled. kv-cache indices look aligned but attention outputs are wrong.
charlie: likely head_layout/packing or rotary head permutation. also check tokenizer normalization differences.
alice: ran a quick tokenizer audit: Qwen variants apply NFKC, Gemma/Llama keep identity. int4 export shows packed head layout.
diane: short-term mitigation: invalidate kvcache on any model-variant switch that changes token_norm or head_layout and re-tokenize with canonical normalizer.
infra-bot: deploy: canary route now invalidates kvcache-on-variant-switch (eng-ml-canary) :white_check_mark:.
eval-bot: eval snapshot: baseline BLEU 28.1, no-invalidate BLEU 9.3, post-invalidate BLEU 27.9; regressions concentrated on long-context (>1024) sessions.
alice: action items: PR to default invalidate-on-switch, router metadata checks (token_norm, head_layout, rotary_format, pack_factor), and a token-normalizer shim for legacy models. I'll run a scanner across onboarded models (gemma-lite, qwen-variants, mistralx) and post results.
charlie: when re-enabling reuse later, add epsilon fuzz-checks on kv keys and rotary phases to avoid silent drift.
diane: I'll inventory models and coordinate owners for fixes.
